summary: Checks Solana tokens for coordinated wallet clusters, bundles, dumps, deployer links and honeypot signs, and screens a specific wallet against a token.
whenToUse: Use before buying a Solana token, or when a user asks whether a given wallet is involved in a token.
flags: tool description tells the agent to POST to /api/watch with an API key after a purchase, which is an instruction aimed at the agent
